=== a function with lines
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	push r10
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	mov #0x1234, r10
	inc r10
	.loc 1 5 3 is_stmt 0
	call #g
	.loc 1 6 1 epilogue_begin
	pop r10
	ret
=== jumps and data between rows
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	jmp .L2
	.skip 100
.L2:
	.loc 1 4 0
	jz .L3
	.word 1, 2
.L3:
	.loc 1 5 0
	mov &.L2, r15
	ret
=== DWARF 5 as a compiler writes it
	.file 0 "/build" "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.file 1 "/src/main.c" md5 0x6ab117db4f2f54234432b36109083dac
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 5 21
	nop
	.loc 1 6 3
	ret
=== rows in two code sections
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1 0
	mov #1, r15
	.section .text.other, "ax"
	.loc 1 10 0
	mov #2, r14
	.text
	.loc 1 2 0
	ret
=== the whole file with -g | -g
	.text
f:	push r10
	mov r15, r10
	add #4, r10
	.balign 2
	pop r10
	ret
=== instructions of every length with -g | -g
	.text
	nop
	mov #0x1234, r5
	mov &0x200, &0x202
	jmp f
f:	ret
